_comment: Search titles and descriptions for the web manual's chapters, keyed by chapter slug. The chapters themselves are generated by scripts/sync-loom-manual.py and say nothing about search; a chapter missing here falls back to its own title and first paragraph. Titles stay under about 50 characters, because the layout appends ' | LOOM Manual'. No em dashes.

welcome.title: Getting Started with LOOM, the Mac Live Looper
welcome.description: Open your audio interface, hear your input and record your first loop in LOOM, a live looper for Mac with audio and MIDI instrument tracks.

keyboard.title: LOOM Keyboard Shortcuts
keyboard.description: Every keyboard shortcut in LOOM: the menu bar, the main window, faders, pan, mute and solo, the effect slots, the tempo field and the record ring.

midi-mapping.title: MIDI Mapping for Foot and Pad Controllers
midi-mapping.description: The MIDI notes that run every LOOM track and the transport. Set up a foot controller or pad controller to record, overdub, stop, undo and clear loops.

privacy.title: Privacy: LOOM Makes No Network Calls
privacy.description: LOOM collects nothing and makes no network calls. It never calls home, checks your licence online or fetches anything, so venue WiFi never matters.

the-window.title: The LOOM Window: Looper, Arrange and Mixer
the-window.description: How the LOOM window is laid out, the words the manual uses precisely, how to play the arrangement, and what accessible means in LOOM.

top-bar.title: The Top Bar: Transport, Tempo and Click
top-bar.description: LOOM's top bar: the song, the transport, RECORD, TEMPO, the click and beat LEDs, the bar, beat and tick position, and the view switcher.

track-strips.title: Loop Tracks, Rings and Overdubs
track-strips.description: How LOOM's loop tracks work: the ring that shows what your next press will do, record and overdub, quantized start and stop, undo, and the globals row.

the-arrange-view.title: The Arrange View: Automate Your Looper
the-arrange-view.description: Draw REC, DUB and PLAY regions on a timeline and LOOM's looper plays the song for you. Automate faders, effects, instruments and whole FX racks.

the-mixer.title: The Mixer, Effects, Racks and Presets
the-mixer.description: LOOM's mixer: banks, the MAIN, CUE, FX 1 and FX 2 fader destinations, eight insert slots per strip, the built-in effects, presets, racks and routing.

side-panel.title: The Side Panel: Global, Track and Song Settings
side-panel.description: The side panel's GLOBAL, TRACK and SONG tabs: input routing, quantize, record modes, loop length and the settings each song and track starts with.

bottom-rails.title: Notices, CPU, Dropouts and the MIDI Monitor
bottom-rails.description: The notice line and status rail at the bottom of LOOM: the audio device, sample rate, buffer, round trip latency, CPU, dropouts and the last MIDI message.

dialogs.title: Saving and Opening Songs, and Record Setup
dialogs.description: LOOM's dialogs: save and open a song, the warning before you lose a take, the session log, and record setup for multitrack performance recording.

instrument-tracks.title: Instrument Tracks: Synth, Drum Machine and Sampler
instrument-tracks.description: Loop MIDI on LOOM's instrument tracks with its own synth, drum machine and sampler. Change the sound while the loop plays, and undo overdubs pass by pass.

your-recordings.title: Where Your Loops and Recordings Are Saved
your-recordings.description: Every take in LOOM is a WAV file on your own disk. Where songs, loops and multitrack performance recordings are saved, and how to back them up.

your-licence.title: Your LOOM Licence and the Free Trial
your-licence.description: How LOOM's 14-day trial and one-time licence work. The licence is a file checked on your Mac at launch, with no account and no activation server.

reporting-a-problem.title: Reporting a Problem with LOOM
reporting-a-problem.description: If LOOM does something you did not expect, it writes a report to a file you can send. What the report contains and where to send it.
